data.name: Eutychus
data.gender_notes: Eutychus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word eu (true, good) and tyche (Goddess of fortune). The name Eutychus means 'true fortune' or 'real and genuine'. In the New Testament, Eutychus is a man who is raised from the dead by the apostle Paul. The name Eutychus carries the meaning “True, Real, Genuine” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eutychus usually hope their child will grow to embody true, real, genuine and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing truth, authenticity, and divine favor.
data.etymology: Eutychus belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “True, Real, Genuine.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eutychus total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
